$schema.description: Path to this JSON Schema: editor autocomplete only, ignored by the loader.

tapMs.description: How long the perfect and human bots hold a tap, in ms; must stay under `feel.input.holdMinMs` so the tap is a Parry.

isEnabled.description: The perfect and human bots do the house chores of a level that has stations (story 9.4). False: they never tap a station.

quietMinMs.description: How long no threat must have been active before a bot starts or resumes a chore, in ms: chores are done in the lulls.

chores.description: How the perfect and human bots do the house chores (story 9.4).

reactionMeanMs.description: Mean time the human bot needs to react to a sight or a signal, in ms: its press is never before the telegraph plus a draw around this.

reactionSdMs.description: Standard deviation of that reaction time, in ms (Gaussian, one draw per response; 0 takes no draw).

reactionMinMs.description: Shortest reaction time the human bot can draw, in ms: nobody reacts faster.

offsetMs.description: Where the human bot aims relative to the window's centre on this display, in ms (negative = early, 0 = dead centre).

sdMs.description: Standard deviation of the human bot's press (or release) around that aim, in ms (Gaussian); capped so that a press stays in its cycle.

withChronoRing.description: The chrono-ring is shown (the game always shows it since story 2.11).

offsetMs.description: Where the human bot aims relative to the window's centre on this display, in ms (negative = early, 0 = dead centre).

sdMs.description: Standard deviation of the human bot's press (or release) around that aim, in ms (Gaussian); capped so that a press stays in its cycle.

withoutChronoRing.description: The chrono-ring is hidden (the conditions of the 2026-11-03 playtest: `npm run sim -- --chrono-ring off`).

readError.description: The timing error of a press on a parry or a Firmness, by what the player is shown.

aimOffsetMs.description: Where the human bot aims on a rhythm or a signal with no chrono-ring (beats, wait, breath), in ms (negative = early, 0 = dead centre).

jitterSdMs.description: Standard deviation of the human bot's press on a rhythm or a signal, in ms (Gaussian).

missWhileBusyPct.description: Chance, in %, that the human bot never answers a threat it first sees while busy elsewhere (finger down, another press planned, Papa asleep, drinking, on the phone or on the toilet); 0 = never. A false alarm it misses is not braced for either: no held breath, no gasp.

backTurnedSdMs.description: Extra standard deviation, in ms, of the human bot's aim at a threat's window while Papa works at a chore's station (story 9.4: his back is turned to the baby, he reads the room worse); 0 = none. Gaussian, added to the ring's read error, so the cost grows smoothly with the value: one more draw per response planned in a chore, none otherwise.

widthPx.description: Width of the screen the human bot plays on, in CSS px (the game canvas): 844 is the e2e viewport, a landscape phone. With `heightPx` it sets how much of the big room's follow frame the bot sees (story 9.8).

heightPx.description: Height of that screen, in CSS px. Landscape: under `widthPx`. The bot is compact (a phone) or regular (a tablet) as the client derives it from the short side.

hudBottomPx.description: The bottom of the HUD row, in CSS px from the top of the canvas, as the client measures it on this screen: a threat's icon under it is not seen. An e2e test compares it with the client's measure.

bubbleReadMs.description: Extra time, in ms, the human bot needs to read a threat it first sees through an off-screen bubble (a small icon at the edge) instead of a marker in the play area; 0 = it reacts at the bubble as it would at a marker. No data behind it yet (story 9.8, question 2).

view.description: The screen the human bot plays a follow-camera level on (story 9.8): what it can see of the big room. A fixed-camera level ignores it.

human.description: The `human` bot: a plausible attentive player.

actionsPerSec.description: How many actions the random bot starts per second of sim time, on average.

floorReachM.description: How far from Papa the random bot may tap on the floor, in metres.

maxHoldMs.description: Longest the random bot holds a press, in ms; above `feel.input.holdMinMs` so that it also produces Firmness.

random.description: The `random` bot: a fuzzer that exercises every command.

description: Settings of the automatic players used by `npm run sim` and the autoplay.
